Hero.summary: Since 2024 I have covered premieres and events for Grupo Cadena Media. My work combines preparing interviews, on-the-ground reporting and presenting on camera. I also direct short films. In photography, I'm especially drawn to concerts, portraits and the street.

4-minutos.title: 4 MINUTOS
4-minutos.description: Two neighbourhood boys kill time until a seemingly trivial conversation starts raising far bigger questions. A black-and-white short film inspired by Sueños y pan.
process: The shoot was conceived as a single sequence shot. A problem with the stabiliser forced us to improvise during filming. In the edit I worked on the silences and the shifts in tone of the conversation.
roles: Script, direction, camera and editing — Sofía Chernikova

credits.cast: Eneko Valle García · Fran Vidales Santos

tras-el-sofa.title: Tras el sofá
tras-el-sofa.description: An accident sets off a story of guilt and secrets. A six-minute short shot on a single set in just four hours.
process: I directed the staging with a crew of ten. In the edit I had to fix continuity problems and order the revelations to keep the tension.

credits.art: Ángela Barroso · Cristina García · María Rodríguez

silver-praxis-condicion-perfecta.description: A music video for Silver Praxis shot across several locations, with moving scenes, shots from a car and aerial footage.
process: It was a five-day shoot. I handled the camera, flew the drone and edited the piece without a shot list, building the rhythm of the images from the available footage.

Profile.bio:
I say I tell stories. Sometimes with a camera, sometimes in writing, sometimes by talking to someone and asking questions. I studied Journalism and Audiovisual Communication because I've always found it hard to choose between looking and telling what I see. I suppose I'm still somewhere in between.

In front of a camera I like to react to what's happening, without everything feeling rehearsed. When I interview, I try to listen rather than wait for my turn to ask the next question. Then there's editing: deciding what stays, what goes and where the story really begins.

grupo-cadena-media.description: I cover premieres and events for Grupo Cadena Media. My work spans journalistic preparation, on-the-ground interviews and presenting on camera.
bullets: I research the context of each event and prepare questions to get statements that add information to the coverage.
I find the people at the centre of the event, conduct interviews and adapt the conversation to the circumstances.
I present on camera and shoot cutaways to give the pieces context.

urjcmun.description: I joined the URJCmun Communications team in 2022. In 2026 I became Deputy Director for Social Media, coordinating the conference's social media coverage.
bullets: I designed the look of the Instagram profile and organised a monthly content calendar during the year before the conference.
I took part in selecting the team and ran two training sessions to prepare the coverage.
I assigned the reporters, reviewed the posts and coordinated the production of interviews, photos and videos during the event.

annie-bonnie.description: During my internship at Annie Bonnie I worked on digital communication projects, including content for Yoigo. The work combined writing, video production and performance tracking.
bullets: I wrote blog content and helped plan the editorial calendar across different channels.
I prepared, shot and edited videos for social media, mostly in vertical format.
I conducted interviews and took part in event coverage.
I produced weekly reports on the performance of the accounts, the posts and competitor activity.

isocero.description: At Isocero I handled photo shoots for hotel guests. I managed the whole process, from first contact to delivering the images.
bullets: I offered shoots to guests and directed outdoor portraits of families and couples.
I selected and edited the material in Lightroom, adjusting light, colour and framing.
I presented the photos, handled their sale and prepared the shoots for delivery.

Contact.title: Shall we talk?
